response.justification: The candidate brings genuine geospatial experience (founding GISCollective, building GIS applications for Green Map) and has worked on low-latency, high-throughput systems in DLang at Dunnhumby, which demonstrates relevant systems-programming instincts. However, his professional C++ experience is limited and dated (2014-2015 at National Instruments), he has no Rust experience, and he lacks direct experience with routing engines, navigation guidance, or map-data tile pipelines. Recent years have been focused on TypeScript/Node full-stack product work, which is a meaningful distance from the C++-centric, data-pipeline-heavy role described.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map projects
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work (millions of HTTP requests/sec) at Dunnhumby using DLang
Demonstrated versatility, self-direction, and strong testing/quality culture (TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling)
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and roughly a decade old; no Rust experience
No direct experience with routing engines, navigation guidance, or map-tile data pipelines
Recent roles (2020-present) are predominantly TypeScript/Node web development, far from the role's core stack
